position_sizing.note: These limits are team policy defaults, not facts from Laura's case, and are editable.

risk_profile.return_basis: Price only. Distributions are not reinvested, so income-heavy funds read low here.

before.unresolved_note: Weight inside funds beyond the named top holdings. Sector and country figures still cover it because those are published for the whole fund.

after.unresolved_note: Weight inside funds beyond the named top holdings. Sector and country figures still cover it because those are published for the whole fund.

facility_capacity.basis: Uncapped, and drawn only from the growth sleeve. Capital dedicated to the payment ladder is excluded because it is already committed.

facility_recommended.basis: The team's $100,000 policy cap applied to the figures above.

assumptions.basis: Team planning assumptions, not observed facts. Fat tails are modelled with a Student-t at 5 degrees of freedom rather than a normal distribution.

funding.curve_source: U.S. Department of the Treasury, daily par yield curve
funding.reproducibility: Fixed seed. Any figure shown can be regenerated exactly.

free_capital_2033.basis: The growth sleeve only. The dedicated ladder is not included.

sponsor_range.statement: Based on current portfolio conditions, Laura can communicate a facility contribution range of $35,000 to $200,000 with approximately 80% modelled confidence while retaining full operating funding.
sponsor_range.policy_note: The modelled range sits within the team's $100,000 provisional cap.

why_the_score_is_what_it_is: Growth runway reads 35.9 % weighted revenue CAGR, which scores 92 out of 100.
Valuation reads 31.25 % weighted FCF margin, which scores 89 out of 100.
Theme purity and methodology scores 70 out of 100 on the evidence on file.
what_could_go_wrong: Stock concentration reads 72 % in top ten, scoring 20.
why_laura_should_care: This belongs to growth capital, not to the money dedicated to the ten fixed payments.
Her mandatory payments are protected by dated instruments elsewhere in the portfolio.
Modelled funding probability is 99.9% against the team's 95% floor, so this position does not weaken funding certainty.

review_triggers: Modelled operating funding probability falls below 95%.
Laura's stated objectives or the residency timeline change.
The index methodology or the fund's selection rules change.
Portfolio overlap with another holding increases materially.
A sector concentration limit is breached after a rebalance.
